supercharger_access.notes: Rivian: model years 2022-2025 need a NACS DC adapter to use Tesla Superchargers; the page is the Canadian locale and says North America, so US and Canada.

wheels.notes: 20 inch all-terrain option. 2022 entries carry no wheel size; 2023 sizes assumed.

21 inch road wheel; standard flag inferred (21 is the base road size, no allowed source states it). Counter-evidence: CARB 2023 lists the cheapest R1S rows as 'R1S (22 inch wheels)' $81,500 and 'R1S 20 inch All-Terrain' $82,300, so 21 may not be the standard size on every pack.
